question: Which syllables and formula constitute the head-tuft nyāsa of this mantra?
premises: The sequence yauṃ nauṃ mauṃ nama aiṃ is repeated
The formula uses vaṣaṭ for the head-tuft
inference: The head-tuft nyāsa is formed by yauṃ nauṃ mauṃ nama aiṃ vaṣaṭ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ
plain_english: Say yauṃ, nauṃ, mauṃ, nama, aiṃ, vaṣaṭ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ; this is the head-tuft.
